S.FORM: alang Pudun ga niya mki sku Tayto Keng atu Kingbong go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 36 buwan, 133 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 97% kyan ku 129 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 3% kyan ku 4 hi nya. rhzyal kki'an lingay na Pudun ga Tjaviljaul ru Sapulju. rekisi kayal kyokay qalang Pudun ga ungat kyokay. ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan qalang Pudun ga ungat pqwasan biru. tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ pu*un ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku tajto keŋ atu kiŋβoŋ ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa ** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku * ħi nja rħzjal kkiʔan liŋaj na pu*un ɣa tja*iljaul ru [s|ɕ]apulju reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj qalaŋ pu*un ɣa uŋat kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan qalaŋ pu*un ɣa uŋat pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
